title: External Listing Feeds
description: Connect your website — we'll automatically detect the format and sync your listings.
empty: No external feeds yet. Paste your website URL and we'll figure out the rest.
confirmDelete: Delete this feed and all listings imported from it?
confirmBulkDelete: Delete {{count}} feeds and all listings imported from them?
confirmClearImports: Clear {{count}} imported listings from this feed? The feed itself will stay so you can re-sync.
clearImportsTooltip: Delete imported listings but keep the feed configured
deferredHint: {{count}} listing(s) reached your monthly limit and will be imported automatically next month.
noItemsProcessed: No items have been processed yet.
lookingForListings: Looking for listings — this can take up to a minute on large sites.
incompleteListingsBody: {{count}} of your listings from this source are missing an address, city, or price. Editing them will help buyers find your properties.
incompleteListingsBodyGeneric: Some of your newly imported listings may be missing an address, city, or price. Editing them helps buyers find your properties.
wizardDesc: Paste your website or feed URL — we'll probe it and detect the format automatically.

method.urlDesc: Auto-detect format from any real estate website
method.rssDesc: Paste a direct RSS or Atom feed URL
method.rssHint: Paste the direct RSS or Atom feed URL for your listings.
method.sampleJsonDesc: Paste a sample from your API response
method.sampleJsonHint: Paste a sample JSON response from your listings API — we'll figure out the field mapping for you.
method.customApiHint: Enter your API endpoint URL and authentication details. We'll probe it and map the fields automatically.

fields.name: Feed name
fields.adapterConfigHint: JSON object with feed URLs, selectors, headers, etc.
fields.fieldMapHint: Map your source's fields to BalkanEstate property fields. Example: { "title": "name", "price": "price.amount" }

preview.title: Choose listings to add to your drafts
preview.subtitle: Found {{total}} listings from {{source}}. Nothing is published yet — the ones you check go to Imported drafts, where you can review, edit and publish each one.
preview.noSelection: Check the listings you want to review
preview.empty: No listings found on this source.
preview.cancelConfirmBody: Your selections will be lost. You can start a new preview anytime.

adapter.rssDesc: Standard RSS or Atom feed of new listings.
adapter.jsonFeedDesc: Any JSON endpoint that returns an array of listings.
adapter.xmlFeedDesc: Generic XML feed; we parse it into JSON before mapping.
adapter.jsonLdDesc: Pages with embedded schema.org RealEstateListing JSON-LD.
adapter.customApiDesc: REST endpoint with optional bearer / API-key auth and pagination.

review.title: Imported drafts
review.description: Listings fetched from your feeds wait here until you check them. Fix anything that was read wrong, then publish or reject.
review.emptyPending: Nothing to review. New listings from your feeds will appear here before they are published.
review.blockingHint: Add the missing details before publishing.
review.limitReached: You reached your monthly listing limit — the remaining listings were not published.
review.bannerBody: Nothing from your feeds is published until you approve it.
review.syncQueuedTitle: Listings are waiting for your review
review.syncQueuedBody: {{count}} listings from this sync were added to Imported drafts. Nothing has been published yet.
review.livePreview: Live preview — what buyers will see
review.unsavedHint: You have unsaved changes. Publishing will save them first.
review.formHint: This listing came from your external feed. Fix anything that was read wrong — it's checked and published like any new listing, then you're taken back to Imported drafts.
